newsitem.title: USA: Blimpie February same-store sales up 5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Blimpie February same-store sales up 5 pct.

text.p: Blimpie International Inc said Tuesday average same-store sales last month were up 5 percent compared to February 1996.
"This is the highest comparable sales growth rate in 26 months," Blimpie said, attributing much of the increase to a brand-building marketing program launched in 1995.
The company, which describes itself as the second-largest sandwich franchisor, said sales at units at least three years old have been steadily increasing since October.
